summary: Frontend production build passed, but managed frontend and backend services are unavailable because supervisor points to nonexistent /app/frontend and /app/backend directories.

critical.issue: Backend supervisor is FATAL: /app/backend does not exist, so API availability could not be verified.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend supervisor is FATAL: /app/frontend does not exist; localhost:3000 refuses connections, so browser E2E flows could not run.

action_items: Update supervisor frontend working directory/command to the actual /app/web project and restart frontend.
Update supervisor backend working directory/command to the actual API project and restart backend.
Provide /app/memory/test_credentials.md before auth retesting; the file is missing.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth.tsx contains hardcoded admin credentials; avoid exposing credentials in frontend bundles and use the intended seeded/configured source.
The app uses relative /api URLs and web/.env is empty; verify the production proxy/base URL contract after services are corrected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: yarn build in /app/web passes. No Playwright or API tests could execute because supervisor services are FATAL and localhost:3000 is unavailable. Missing credential file blocks auth testing.
rca of the issue: Supervisor still references the old /app/frontend and /app/backend layout, while the repository contains /app/web and API modules at the repository root. Both processes fail during chdir before application startup.
